title: ObjectionResponse
description: An [Objection](/api-reference/settlement-management/models/objection) (Einspruch) filed against settlement data within a clearing period.

created_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this objection was created.
created_ts.title: Created Ts

disputed_values.description: Free-form data describing the disputed values (dates, intervals, amounts).
disputed_values.title: Disputed Values

last_modified_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the most recent status change.
last_modified_ts.title: Last Modified Ts

resolved_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the objection was resolved (accepted or rejected).
resolved_ts.title: Resolved Ts

submitted_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the objection was submitted to the TSO.
submitted_ts.title: Submitted Ts

tso_response.description: TSO response text, if the objection has been reviewed.
tso_response.title: Tso Response
